result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: layout, spacing, icons, chips, promo banner, and bottom navigation are aligned and legible. The main findings are a duplicated restaurant card and a few minor readability and styling concerns. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intentional.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' row shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, delivery time, and fee, which looks like duplicated data.
issues.suggestion: Verify the restaurant feed and remove the duplicate entry, or show distinct restaurants.

issues.description: The delivery-time pills (e.g., '15–25 min') sit directly over the food images and partially cover the poké bowls and burger.
issues.suggestion: Position the time badges in a consistent corner or below the image so they don't obscure the product photography.

issues.description: Secondary gray text such as the rating count '(500+)', the delivery fee lines, and the meta line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' is light gray on white, which may fall below recommended contrast for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1) for small text.
